title: LRT Detector
text: Likelihood ratio test detector, 3 inputs, 3 outputs; {Probability of false alarm}, {Output format} sets the format of output data, {Output detection statistics and threshold} and {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Y
ports.summary: Detection results 1-by- M logical-valued vector | 1-by- L integer-valued vector

ports.name: Stat
ports.summary: Detection statistics D -by- M (default) | matrix | 1-by- L vector
